layers.name: Reserve outer boundary (2023 extent, as far as public files draw it)
layers.reliability: Official files joined; about 180 km² of the notified reserve has no public map and is not included.

layers.name: Reserve and eco-sensitive zones, outer boundary
layers.reliability: Official files joined. Covers the reserve outline above plus both notified eco-sensitive zones, which also take in all nine village enclaves inside the Bhainsrorgarh sanctuary file and part of the unmapped 2023 buffer. Some 2023 buffer additions near Kota and in Bundi, and part of the 2023 core villages (the OpenStreetMap point for Kolpura is about 0.5 km outside), may still fall outside.

layers.name: Core 2013 (approximate)
layers.reliability: Approximate. No official file draws the core. This layer counts about 18 km² of Jawahar Sagar and Darrah buffer blocks as core and misses the 7.75 km² National Chambal core part. It also includes 6.7 km² of village holes that the reserve file leaves open (nearly all Girdharpura, which the Tiger Conservation Plan lists as a core village) and 2.6 km² around Borabas that only the Jawahar Sagar file draws.

layers.name: Buffer 2013 (approximate)
layers.reliability: Approximate, with the same misassignment as the core layer in reverse.

layers.name: Core added 2023: Bhainsrorgarh WLS forest blocks
layers.reliability: Official sanctuary file (2018). The notification adds 12 forest blocks (193.09 km²); the file draws the whole sanctuary, so the two differ. Sanctuary area is 201.4 km² in the file's attribute but 275.45 km² in the 2021 ESZ notification.

layers.name: Buffer added 2023: whole blocks a public file draws, outside the 2013 files
layers.reliability: Only the three blocks the notification adds whole (Barkheda, Rawtha, Borabas-B; 2.74 km² notified), which the Kota file draws at 1.84 km². Rawtha and Borabas-B lie almost wholly inside the 2013 files, so this layer is the other 0.92 km², nearly all Barkheda. The file draws Borabas-B at 0.50 km² against 1.38 km² notified. Part-blocks, compartments, the Bundi additions and the National Chambal piece have no public map.

layers.name: Eco-sensitive zone around MHTR (2020)
layers.reliability: Official ESZ file minus the reserve, park and sanctuary files. Notified as 0–1 km but about 5.4 km wide near Rawatbhata. Drawn around the 2013 reserve; it crosses forest blocks partly added to the buffer in 2023, and no file shows whether the added parts fall inside it. The Girdharpura village hole in the reserve file is counted as reserve, not ESZ.

layers.name: Eco-sensitive zone around Bhainsrorgarh WLS (2021)
layers.reliability: Official ESZ file minus the sanctuary and reserve files. Within 1.5% of the notified 304.70 km². The notification gives a width of 0–9.6 km, zero to the north and north-east where Jawahar Sagar and the national park adjoin. The file's BUFF_DIST attribute (3000) does not describe the drawn band.

layers.name: Mukundara Hills National Park (constituent unit)
layers.reliability: Official sanctuary or park file (2018). Outline only; it does not show core or buffer. Notified area is the file's own NOTIFY_ARE attribute.
